categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the glass deep processing industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of processed glass products. Key product lines include household appliance glass, kitchen appliance glass, Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) glass, and glass for new energy vehicle charging piles. The company serves industries such as home appliances, photovoltaics, construction, automotive, and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced glass processing technologies including printing, coating (e.g., anti-fingerprint, anti-glare, anti-reflection coatings), multi-curved surface shaping, tempering, and lamination. It employs automated production lines with laser cutting, automatic grinding, and automated inspection systems to enhance product quality and efficiency. The firm also focuses on R&D for innovative materials and processes such as high-temperature UV micro-nano texture, ultra-thin laminated decorative panels, and localized coating techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large domestic and international home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Electrolux, Whirlpool, Hisense, Midea, Hitachi, Panasonic, Bosch, and Fotile. The company also supplies photovoltaic component manufacturers and construction firms for BIPV products, as well as manufacturers of new energy vehicle charging infrastructure. The markets served include domestic China and export markets abroad.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and production facilities in Jiangsu Province. It has expanded overseas by establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary in Thailand to serve international markets and mitigate geopolitical and supply chain risks. Sales are split between domestic (55%) and export markets (45%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork operates primarily in the midstream segment of the glass supply chain, focusing on deep processing of flat glass into specialized finished glass products. It procures raw flat glass upstream and supplies processed glass downstream to appliance manufacturers, photovoltaic companies, and automotive charging infrastructure providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product differentiation through continuous R&D investment, focusing on high-performance coatings, multi-functional glass products, and smart glass technologies. It actively collaborates with universities and research institutes, holds numerous patents, and pursues projects in smart glass production lines and BIPV component manufacturing. The firm also emphasizes automation upgrades and cost control to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of processed glass products to large appliance manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company also earns income from photovoltaic power generation sales and financial investments. Sales are conducted via contracts and direct shipments, including supplier-managed inventory models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech glass deep processing enterprise in China, with strong R&D capabilities and a broad customer base including top-tier domestic and international appliance brands. It competes in a fragmented industry with many players but differentiates through technology, product quality, and customer service. Its strategic overseas expansion aims to strengthen its global market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, a 10.39% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 219.4 million, up 5.47%. Total assets reached RMB 3.07 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork emphasizes high-quality, innovative glass products with enhanced functionalities such as anti-fingerprint, anti-glare, and smart control features. Its products offer aesthetic appeal, durability, and customized solutions tailored to customer needs in home appliances, photovoltaics, and new energy sectors. The company leverages advanced manufacturing automation and proprietary technologies to deliver superior product performance and cost advantages.
